name: board
description: Excalidraw diagrams that live in the repo: Claude draws them, reads them back as a graph, and writes code from them. Includes a live local board you can draw on at the same time.

board.//: From npm, not from ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}: installing a plugin copies files into a cache without running npm install, so the sources here have no dependencies and no build output. Version pinned to this manifest's version so a cached plugin cannot silently pick up a newer server.
